assessment.subject: Mathematics
assessment.question: Explain how to add 1/3 and 1/4.
assessment.correct_answer: Use a common denominator: 1/3 = 4/12 and 1/4 = 3/12, so the sum is 7/12.

The answer is 2/7 because you add straight across.
Change both denominators to 12 but keep the numerators 1 and 1, giving 2/12.
Use twelfths, then add 1/12 and 1/12 to make 2/12.
The denominators become 12, so I wrote 1/12 + 1/12 = 2/12.
Multiply 1/3 by 1/4 and get 1/12.
Three quarters is larger, so the answer is 1/4.

cases.material:
To add fractions with unlike denominators, first rewrite both fractions using a common denominator. For 1/3 and 1/4, the least common denominator is 12. Multiply both the numerator and denominator of 1/3 by 4 to get 4/12. Multiply both parts of 1/4 by 3 to get 3/12. Then add the numerators while keeping the common denominator: 4/12 + 3/12 = 7/12.

A fraction names equal parts of one whole. Adding denominators directly changes the size of the parts and therefore does not represent the original quantities. Multiplying fractions is a different operation from adding fractions. Always check that the fractions describe parts of the same size before combining their numerators.

Equivalent fractions have the same value even though they use different numbers. A number line or fraction strips can show that 1/3 equals 4/12 and 1/4 equals 3/12. These visual models help verify the common-denominator method.

assessment.subject: Mathematics
assessment.question: A rectangle is 8 cm long and 3 cm wide. Find its area and explain.
assessment.correct_answer: Area measures the surface in square units, so multiply 8 cm by 3 cm to get 24 square centimeters.

responses.answer: Add all four sides: 8 + 8 + 3 + 3 = 22 square centimeters.
The area is 22 because the perimeter around it is 22.

Eight plus three plus eight plus three equals 22, so that is the area.
Add 8 and 3 to get 11 square centimeters.
Length plus width gives the area, so 8 + 3 = 11.

There are 8 rows and 3 columns, so 8 times 3 is 24 centimeters.
An 8 by 3 array has 24 unit squares, so the area is 24 square centimeters.

cases.material:
Area measures the amount of flat surface inside a shape and is reported in square units. For a rectangle, multiply its length by its width. An 8 centimeter by 3 centimeter rectangle contains 8 columns of 3 unit squares, so its area is 8 times 3, or 24 square centimeters.

Perimeter measures the distance around the outside edge of a shape. For an 8 centimeter by 3 centimeter rectangle, add all four sides: 8 + 3 + 8 + 3 = 22 centimeters. Perimeter uses linear units, while area uses square units.

A useful check is to draw a grid inside the rectangle. Counting rows and columns models multiplication and shows why adding only the length and width does not find the surface area.

representative_answers: The area is 22 because the perimeter around it is 22.
